Name: Interiors of Pelican Town - Caroline's Sunroom
Author: QueenAcademe
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

The "Interiors of Pelican Town" suite of mods redesigns the homes and common spaces of Pelican Town. This installation redesigns Caroline's Sunroom.

[b]Compatibility[/b] 

Interiors of Pelican Town - Caroline's Sunroom is natively compatible with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url].
